model.description: Tower Three presents Maple Butter, a premium 3.5g flower offering that brings together rich, indulgent flavor with quality cannabis. This expertly cultivated flower delivers smooth, sweet maple notes complemented by creamy, buttery undertones that create a uniquely satisfying aromatic experience. Each bud is carefully hand-trimmed and cured to preserve terpene integrity and cannabinoid potency. The flavor profile unfolds with warm maple sweetness on the inhale, followed by smooth, buttery richness that lingers pleasantly. Perfect for cannabis enthusiasts seeking distinctive flavor alongside quality effects. Tower Three's commitment to cultivation excellence shines through in every jar, delivering consistent potency and exceptional taste. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or exploring new flavor profiles, Maple Butter offers a memorable experience that stands out from typical flower options. This 3.5g size provides the perfect amount to enjoy and share.
